text: Healthy living is about taking care of both your body and your mind. First, eat a balanced diet with plenty of fruit, vegetables, and water, and avoid too much fast food. Second, try to exercise regularly — even a short walk every day makes a difference. Good sleep is also important, so aim for seven to eight hours each night. Don't forget your mental health: talk to friends and family when you feel stressed. Finally, keep a healthy work-life balance by making time for rest and hobbies. Small daily habits like these can help you feel happier and more energetic.
